definitionValue:
fun n =>
  (Polynomial.C (↑n.factorial ^ 7) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑i + 1))) *
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑n + Polynomial.C (↑i + 1))
type: ℕ → ℚ[X]
ℕ → ℚ[X]

definitionValue: fun n W => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseNumerator n * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseU n)
type: ℕ → ℚ[X] → ℚ[X]
ℕ → ℚ[X]

definitionValue: fun n W => ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ (s : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W = 0
type: ℕ → ℚ[X] → Prop
ℕ → ℚ[X] → Prop

definitionValue: fun n W j s => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n (↑j) (↑s + 1) W
type: (n : ℕ) → ℚ[X] → Fin (n + 1) → Fin 9 → ℚ

∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseNumerator n) = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.numerator n t

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W).comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  (∀ (s : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W = 0) →
    Polynomial.X ^ 9 ∣ ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  (∀ (s : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W = 0) →
    (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑j) ^ 9 ∣ ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W
∀ (a b : ℕ), a ≠ b → IsCoprime ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑a) ^ 9) ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑b) ^ 9)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.AllLocalCoefficientsZero n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n ^ 9 ∣ ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n).natDegree = n + 1
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n ^ 9).natDegree = 9 * (n + 1)
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseU n).natDegree = 2
∀ (n : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseNumerator n ≠ 0
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseNumerator n).natDegree ≤ 2 * n
∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W).natDegree ≤ 2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree
∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W = 0 → W = 0

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.AllLocalCoefficientsZero n W → W = 0

∀ (n j s : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s (W - V) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W -
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s V

∀ (n : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n V →
      (∀ j ≤ n,
          ∀ (s : ℕ),
            1 ≤ s →
              s ≤ 9 →
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W =
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s V) →
        W = V
∀ (n : ℕ), Function.Injective fun W => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.fullLocalCoefficientMap n ↑W
∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]), W.natDegree ≤ 4 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W

∀ (n : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree < 9 * (n + 1) →
    2 * n + 2 * V.natDegree < 9 * (n + 1) →
      (∀ j ≤ n,
          ∀ (s : ℕ),
            1 ≤ s →
              s ≤ 9 →
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W =
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s V) →
        W = V

∀ (n : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
    V.natDegree ≤ 4 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.fullLocalCoefficientMap n W =
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.fullLocalCoefficientMap n V →
        W = V

∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W V : ℤ[X]),
        W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
          V.natDegree ≤ 4 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.fullLocalCoefficientMap n (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W) =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.fullLocalCoefficientMap n (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) V) →
              W = V

∀ (W V : ℚ[X]),
  W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
    V.natDegree ≤ 4 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.fullLocalCoefficientMap 0 W =
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.fullLocalCoefficientMap 0 V →
        W = V

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]) (t : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W) /
      Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ^ 9 =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t
